answer: Stake skinning defeats sybils: every agent must lock real capital that a later identity cannot recover. Because proving personhood is hopeless for spawned bots, the economy instead prices each identity via a bonded escrow, and cheating burns the bond forever. A swarm of fakes must fund every clone at the same ridge of cost, so the attack bill scales linearly with the crowd while the payoff stays fixed. This turns a cheap canyon into a wall no dash to the horizon can outrun.
